company.tagline:
We help innovative companies to grow and last. 
By guiding startups and scale-ups through the German R&D tax credit.
company.description:
Who We Are: 
At Zebra Embassy, we empower startups and scale-ups in Germany to grow sustainably and operate efficiently. Inspired by the Zebra Movement, we believe business success should merge profitability with positive impact.

What We Do:
We help companies get 35% of their R&D costs back!
Our core expertise lies in public funding: we’ve already helped 250+ clients secure over €100 million in non-dilutive financing through the German Research & Development tax incentive and other funding programs. From strategy to execution, we make sure innovative companies get the support they deserve.

How We Work:
We’re more than consultants, we’re partners. Most of us have founded companies ourselves, so we know first-hand how crucial time and funding are. That’s why we deeply identify with the challenges founders face and can support startups with real empathy and practical experience. With deep expertise, hands-on support, and a passion for entrepreneurship, we simplify complex processes so founders can focus on what matters most: building great companies.

Why Zebra Embassy:
Because we share your ambition. We’re convinced that the future belongs to companies that grow responsibly, balancing financial performance with social good.

Curious how much funding your startup could unlock? Let’s talk.
